findings.message: All ten values put {recipient} directly before a postposition (تک, کی جانب سے), which requires the oblique genitive کے. This PR newly routes the unnamed form (nominative کا) into these lines, so every delivery line for an unnamed agent renders a visible agreement error. The named form is correct. Suggested fix (not applied by the auditor): a delivery-scoped oblique unnamed key, e.g. ui.teamBridge.delivery.recipient_unnamed = "{person} کے چیف آف اسٹاف", used by deliveryChiefLabels, then a ur re-audit.

out_of_scope_observations: Pre-existing on main, not counted: other keys that embed a chief label before a postposition (e.g. ui.teamBridge.composer.placeholder_to "{name} को/کو …") carry the same oblique-case issue for the unnamed form.
